Thirty Blu #3 by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Big on space, style, and rooftop fun, Thirty Blu #3 is a 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom townhouse in the middle of Blue Mountain Beach. Grab your morning coffee at a nearby café, take a dip in the refreshing community pool, wander down for dinner and live music, or swing by the local bakery on your way back from the beach. With two roomy living areas, a sleek, fully equipped kitchen, and a private rooftop terrace made for sunset lounging, this spot is perfect for families or groups who like a little room to roam. Inside, there’s space for everyone to unwind, with wo floors, two living rooms, and four private bedrooms (so no one’s stuck on the couch). Whip up delicious meals and create fun-filled family memories in the fully furnished kitchen, equipped with everything you need. Managed by Oversee 30A, our local team is just around the corner, always happy to help, and available 24/7 if something comes up. Enjoy! Overview: - 695 steps (.3 miles) to Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access - 2464 sq ft - No pets allowed!
